snippet.title: SHIKA-Q Teaser Trailer | Nintendo Switch Version Now Available for Pre-Order!
snippet.description:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHIKA-Q — Ultra-Fast Competitive Puzzle Game
Now Available for Pre-Order on Nintendo Switch!
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Connect "Links" on a 10×10 board where split-second decisions decide the winner.
Attacks, disruptions, heals, and special moves all unfold in real time — blending the mind games of a fighting game with the strategy of an esport, in a completely new kind of puzzle battle experience.

And at the heart of it all: vocal tracks that sync with the heat of every match, making music and gameplay feel like one.

─────────────────────────────
🔔 Pre-Order Now — 20% OFF During Pre-Order Period!
─────────────────────────────
※ Pre-orders are currently available in Japan/Asia/Southeast Asia.
　 Release date for Europe and North America is TBA.

▶ Nintendo Switch Store
https://store-jp.nintendo.com/item/software/D70010000079799

📅 Pre-Order Period：March 19, 2026 (Thu) — April 8, 2026 (Wed) 23:59
🚀 Sale Start：April 9, 2026 (Thu) 00:00

─────────────────────────────
🎁 Pre-Order Bonus (4 Items)
─────────────────────────────
・Player Icons ×2
　"Pioneer's Mark [Blue]_P Icon" / "Pioneer's Mark [Red]_P Icon"
・Battle BGM ×1　"Wind Racer"
・Achievement Badge ×1　"Genesis Challenger"
※ Cosmetic items only — no effect on gameplay performance or balance.

─────────────────────────────
🎮 Game Overview
─────────────────────────────
Title：SHIKA-Q
Genre：Ultra-Fast Competitive Puzzle Game
Players：1–2 (Online Multiplayer Supported)
Distribution：Digital Only
CERO：A
Platforms：Nintendo Switch / PlayStation®4 / PlayStation®5 / Steam
Languages：Japanese / English / Chinese (Simplified & Traditional) / Korean / French / German / Spanish / Portuguese / Italian / Dutch

─────────────────────────────
🧪 Steam Playtest (Demo) 
─────────────────────────────
Period：March 19, 2026 (Thu) ~20:00 — April 5, 2026 (Sun) 23:59
▶ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4083790/SHIKAQ/

─────────────────────────────
🔗 Links
─────────────────────────────
🌐 Official Site：https://shika-q.com
🐦 Official X (Twitter)：https://x.com/sikaq_info
🎮 Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4083790/SHIKAQ/
